Commentary.Commentary: The total now is not a big one and Windies would fancy themselves to chase this down. Will they take a 1-0 lead or will Bangladesh come roaring back? Join us to find out.

For Windies, their pacers were brilliant. Their ploy of playing 4 pacers worked for them. Sheldon Cottrell was the pick of the bowlers for them picking up 4 wickets. He was well-supported by the rest. Every bowler except for Powell managed to pick a wicket.

Bangladesh came out with an attacking approach after electing to bat. They did manage to score runs but lost wickets at regular interval. They scored 54 in their Powerplay but lost a total of 4 wickets. Shakib then continued but received minimal support from the other end. He got to his fifty but fell at the wrong time for Bangladesh. The lower order failed to contribute and hence, the hosts failed to play out their full quote of overs.
Sensational bowling performance from Windies. Bangladesh have been all out for 129. Carlos Brathwaite will be a happy man going into the dressing room with a target of 130 to chase.

OUT! That is it! BANGLADESH HAVE BEEN BOWLED OUT FOR 129! Paul gets his second in the over. It is on the stumps, Rahman plays a nothing shot, fails to put bat on ball and it makes a mess of the stumps.
Length again around off, the batsman guides it to point.
Mustafizur Rahman is the last man in for Bangladesh.
OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! No. 9 down! It is on a length outside off, Hasan goes for the heave but only manages to get a faint edge to Hope who takes an easy catch.
Shortish and around off, Hider is late on his pull, it goes down to long on for a run.
Now hits it down to long on to follow the boundary with a single.
FOUR! Ideal start to the over! A poor ball! Short and wide outside off, Hasan cuts it through point and the ball races away.
Keemo Paul to bowl the 19th.
Very full and on middle, the batsman works it back to the bowler.
Shortish and on the body, the batter works it towards square leg for a single.
Back of a length on off, the batsman guides it to point.
Abu Hider is the new man.

OUT! That's the big fish! The skipper cannot see off this inning. The over pitched delivery is followed up with a short one. Shakib tries to pull this one over square leg for a maximum but gets the top edge on it and Cottrell takes an easy one. A good innings from the skipper comes to an end. He did not have any firm support from the other end and with this wicket the Windies have easily reduced 10-15 runs from the total they will be chasing.

SIX! Over pitched on off, Shakib gets his front foot out of the line and heaves it through mid on for a maximum. A very loose delivery by Cottrell. Shakib's eyes lit up as soon as he saw that delivery.
Length delivery on off, Miraz defends it off the back foot and quickly gets off the strike.

FOUR! A boundary to end the over! A lucky one. However, it is still an excellent over, 5 and a wicket from it. Shakib comes down the track and swings blindly. The ball takes the outside edge, goes away from the keeper and down to the third man fence.
Only a single now as Hasan works it towards mid on.
Short and outside off, Hasan tries to cut but misses. 4 dots so far in this over.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
A yorker to begin with. Hasan jams it out.
Mehidy Hasan is the next batsman in.

OUT! He strikes straightaway! Poor, very poor by Saifuddin. He has his skipper on the other end who is striking the ball very well. He should be giving him the strike but no, he clears his front leg and tries to clear the man at long on. Does not get it off the middle and Pooran at long on runs in and takes an easy catch. Bangladesh now in danger of being bowled out.
Carlos Brathwaite is back on.

SIX! Fifty for the skipper! His 8th in this format. He is leading from the front and holds the key for Bangladesh if they are to get to a competitive total. Shakib charges down the track and lofts it over mid-wicket for a wonderful maximum.
Saifuddin gets off the mark with a flick down the leg side.

OUT! Windies have broken this partnership as these two were trying to steady the ship here. Tossed up on middle, Haque was tempted to play the slog sweep, he couldn't resist and goes for it. He cannot time it well and the ball goes straight into the hands of Nicholas Pooran at deep square leg.
Tossed up on off, Shakib plays it to the point region for a single.
A bit shorter on this occasion, Hasan rocks onto his back foot and hits it straight to Allen.
Tossed up on middle, Shakib plays it straight back to the bowler.

FOUR! Finally a boundary for Haque. He was looking for the boundary since the first ball but he gets a boundary this time. It was a length delivery on off, Haque lofts it over mid off and the ball races away to the fence. Still a good over for the Windies. Just 4 from the over.

Length delivery on off, Ariful pushes it towards covers. The batsman goes for the run but the non- striker was not interested in the run and sends him back. Allen has a shy at the stumps but misses the stumps. Ariful would have been a goner if it had hit the stumps. 5 back to back dot balls for Paul.
Back of a length on middle, Ariful defends it off the back foot and onto the ground.
Back of a length on middle, Haque tries to guide it towards third man but the ball hits the upper half of the bat and the ball goes towards the bowler.
Similar delivery, same result.
Length delivery on off, Arful cuts it straight to the backward point fielder.
Keemo Paul is back on.
Length delivery on leg, flicks the pad of the skipper.
Shorter delivery by Thomas, Haque beautifully pulls it away to the fine leg region. But there's a fielder in the deep so the batsman will only get a run.
Length delivery on off, the skipper pulls it away through mid-wicket for a single.
Shorter on length, Shakib cuts it away but straight to the fielder at backward point.

Fuller on off on this occassion, Shakib drives it through covers,Lewis makes the distance from deep point to stop the ball going away to the boundary. He dives to his left and saves 2 runs for his side.
Length delivery on off, Ariful flicks it away to square leg to rotate the strike.
Works it away with the angle for a single. So only 7 from the over despite going for a boundary on the first ball.
Driven nicely down towards long off but only for a single.
Back of a length around off, Hasan tries to guide it to third man. The shot is not on though as it is too close to the off pole. He ends up chopping it to point.
That stays low! It is bowled outside off, Shakib swings but misses as the ball does not bounce as he anticipates it to.
On the middle stump, Ariful works it through mid-wicket and a run is taken.

FOUR! Welcome to the attack, Powell. A loosener to begin with and a much-needed boundary for Bangladesh. It is short and on the body, Haque swivels and pulls it through backward square leg. The ball races away.
Rovman Powell is on now.
Drifting down the leg, Haque tries to flick but misses it and the ball hits the pad. The ball is missing the leg stump and goes towards the square leg region. The batsmen pick up a single.
Flighted delivery outside off, Arif opens the face of the bat and guides it away through backward point for a couple.
Pitching outside leg, Haque shows his pads to it.
A tad fuller on this occasion and Shakib defends it and calls for a quick single.
FOUR! Too short on this occasion by Allen, Shakib goes onto his back foot and pulls it away through mid-wicket for a boundary. Shakib will have no problem putting away such bad deliveries.
Shorter on length, Ariful flicks  it away towards mid-wicket for a single.
Full and outside off, the batter guides it down to third man and a run is taken. So the runs are also hard to come by now. Just 11 from the last three and also a wicket.
A short delivery which has been pulled away. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Good length on off, it is kept out.
Back of a length around off, Haque guides it through point for a run.
WIDE! Way outside off, it is left alone.
Ariful Haque is the new batsman.

OUT! He has! Good take by Hope and Bangladesh now have half the side back in the hut. The bowling change has worked wonders for Windies. Also, it is a timely wicket as the partnership was building up well. It is the slower ball around off, Mahmudullah tries to guide it towards third man. The ball though kisses the outside edge and goes low towards Hope. He dives and seems to have taken it. He does claim it and the umpire at first raises the finger. Mahmudullah starts walking but then is stopped by the umpire as he wants to be sure. It is taken upstairs. Replays show that it is clean as a whistle. Windies are ecstatic.
Has that carried? Hope is not sure, however, Tanvir Ahmed first had his finger up but then, just to be sure has taken it upstairs. Hope seems to be confident.
Starts off with a length ball around off, it is kept out.
Sheldon Cottrell is back on.
Shorter on length this time, defended off the back foot by the skipper.
Tossing it up on off is Allen, Mahmudullah pushes it to cover for a single.
Flighted delivery on middle, the right-hander pushes it straight to the fielder at mid off.
A bit shorter on length this time on off, Mahmudullah defends it away off his back foot.
Loopy delivery on middle, the southpaw pushes it away to the fielder at long on for a single.
Tossed up on middle to start the spell, Mahmudullah tucks it away towards mid-wicket for a single.
Fabian Allen is on now.
Length and outside off, Mahmudullah guides it to third man and rotates strike. So a tight over by Brathwaite, just 4 from this one.
Another single! Windies won't mind this! It is on middle, Shakib nudges it around the corner for a run.
Good use of the wrists. Mahmudullah works it towards mid on from around off for a quick run. This has been a good over till now by the Windies skipper.
Mahmudullah clears his front leg in an attempt to go big. Brathwaite though follows him and cramps him for room. Mahmudullah blocks it out.
Back of a length again around off, the batsman stands tall and then guides it to point.
On the shorter side on middle, Shakib works it through square leg for a single.
On the pads, and Shakib easily flicks it away through mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller on off, the southpaw drives it straight to the fielder at mid on.
FOUR! Over pitched on this occasion by Paul, Hasan looks in great touch and beautifully drives it through covers for a boundary. He will punish such balls everyday of the week.
Length delivery on off, Mahmudullah gets to the pitch of the ball and pushes it away towards cover and rotates the strike.
Shorter on length this time, Shakib pulls it towards deep square leg for a run.
Angling down the leg, Mahmudullah flicks it away for a single.
Length delivery on off, Hasan is through with his back foot defense. The ball hits the upper half of the bat.
Shorter on length on this occasion, the right-hander pulls it away towards fine leg for a single.
Once again Brathwaite angles it on leg, Shakib flicks it away for a single.
On the pads, Mahmudullah flicks it this time through the fine leg region for a single.
Length delivery on middle, Mahmudullah flicks it off his pads straight to fielder at mid-wicket
Length delivery on off, Shakib punches it through covers for a single.
Carlos Brathwaite is on.
Another slower ball and another dot as Mahmudullah fails to guide it down to third man. 6 runs and a wicket from the last over the Powerplay. An action-packed one as the hosts are 54 for 4 after it.
FOUR! Streaky! Bangladesh won't mind though. It is full and outside off, Mahmudullah goes for the drive. The ball takes the outside edge and runs fine to the third man fence.
Smart bowling! Bowls this one very slow outside off, Mahmudullah tries to run it down to third man but misses.
Length ball on middle, Mahmudullah pushes it to mid on.
Just a single from the Free Hit! Goes full and on the pads, Hasan tries to clip it away but fails to do so. The ball hit his pads and rolls towards square leg. The batsmen take a leg bye.
NO BALL! That surely must have slipped out! Paul tries to bowl a slower ball but ends up bowling a high full toss. Shakib ducks under it. The umpire signals it as a no ball and it is Free Hit time.

OUT!!! Mushfiqur Rahim is the 4th batsman back in the hut. Paul starts off with a slower delivery on middle. Rahim defends it and is called for a quick single by his partner. Mushfiqur responds but is quite hesitant, he eventually goes through with it. Powell at covers runs in and quickly grabs the ball. Hits bull's eye at the non-striker's end. The Bangladeshi wicketkeeper is way out of the crease.
Keemo Paul comes onto the attack.
FOUR! Third boundary of the over. Streaky but effective. Short around off, Hasan cuts it hard and the ball flies over the wicket-keepers head to the third man boundary.
Back of a length delivery on middle and leg. Hasan tries to paddle it fine but misses it.
Goes short this time around off. Hasan goes for the pull but misses it completely.
FOUR! Lovely shot. A tad full on off, Al Hasan leans forward and drives it firmly through covers for a boundary.
Back of a length outside off. Rahim opens the face of the bat and the ball goes to the third man region. The batsmen take a single.
FOUR! Rahim off with a delightful boundary. It was a full toss on off, Rahim drives it straight past the bowler and through mid off and the ball races away to the boundary.
Another yorker, a good delivery to end the over. Hasan jams it out. 8 runs from this over but a wicket also. So runs are flowing but wickets are also falling.

FOUR! Innovation and it comes off brilliantly. Despite wickets falling, Shakib is taking the attack to the bowlers. The last ball he moved away from the stumps, this time he moves across, plays the paddle scoop, it goes fine enough and to the fence.
Well bolwed! Shakib makes room but Sheldon follows him with a yorker, the southpaw is cramped for room, not much he can do with it. Shakib jams it out towards the keeper.
Mushfiqur Rahim is the new man in.

OUT!! Third wicket down fro Bangladesh. Soumya Sarkar is the man who is back to the pavillion. Rather than building a partnership Sarkar tries to take charge to Sheldon Cortell. He goes for a pull but the ball hits the upper half of the bat and goes straight to mid on, where Rovman Powell takes an easy catch.

Length delivery outside off, Shakib punches it towards the fielder at point. They go for a quick single. Lewis has a go at the stumps on the non strikers end but misses. There is no back up there and the batsmen take two more runs. 3 runs added to the total.
Fuller on middle, Sarkar finds the inside edge and gets a single.
Length delivery on middle and leg. Al Hasan tucks it straight to the square leg fielder. Eventful over comes to an end.

FOUR! GLORIOUS! Two consecutive boundaries for the captain. A touch short around off, Hasan punches it off the back foot through point and the ball races away to the boundary. The captain looks in good touch.
FOUR! The captain is off the mark with a streaky boundary. It was a tad shot and around off. Shakib cuts it hard and the ball goes over wicket keeper and to the third man boundary.
Back of a length on off, Hasan defends it from within the crease.
Shakib Al Hasan is the new man in.

OUT! Oshane Thomas strikes now! Both the opening bowlers now have a wicket each. Bangladesh have lost their openers. Once again it is the shorter length which does the trick. It is on middle, Das comes down the track and tries to pull it over mid-wicket. He though is beaten by pace, it hits the higher portion of the bat and the ball goes uppishly towards mid off. The captain there, takes an easy catch. 2nd wicket for Windies. Bangladesh in big trouble.
Length delivery on off, Das taps it towards point.

FOUR! So two boundaries after the wicket to end the over. Sarkar is off the mark in style. It is slightly short and outside off, Sarkar goes back and guides it through point. 12 runs from Cottrell's first but he does get the big wicket of Tamim.

FOUR BYES! Another pacey delivery! Short and outside off this time, Sarkar tries to flat-bat towards mid off but is beaten by the extra bounce. Hope is late to react. Fails to collect the ball and it goes to the third man fence.
Soumya Sarkar is the new man in.

OUT!!! Tamim Iqbal is a goner! Big wicket for the Windies. Tamim cannot make the most of the dropped chance. The southpaw wasn't looking comfortable out in the middle today. He tried to pull the length delivery over the square leg region but the ball hit the upper half of the bat and went straight in to the hands of Carlos Brathwaite at mid off. Early strike for the Windies and this is just the start they would have wanted.
Length delivery outside off, Liton charges down and pushes it to mid off for another single.
Length delivery on off, Tamim blocks it off the front foot and takes a quick single.
Length delivery on middle, Tamim pushes it through covers for a couple.
Sheldon Cottrell to bowl from the other end.
Back of a length delivery on off, Tamim plays it with soft hands to the off side and the batsmen rotate strike. Good start for Bangladesh. 7 runs from the first over.
A tad short from Thomas this time around off. Tamim goes for the cut but misses it.
Fuller delivery on middle, Das flicks it to the mid-wicket region for a single.
FOUR! First boundary of the match. Thomas errs in line, it is down leg. Das clips it off his pads and through fine leg for a boundary. Das gets off the mark in style.

DROPPED! Fuller delivery on middle, Tamim drives it uppishly towards mid off. Brathwaite dives to his right, sticks his hand out but can't hang onto it. The batsmen manage to take a run in the process. Would have been a brilliant catch if he had caught that. It had to stick and Windies would have loved that to stick. A let off for Bangladesh's bets batsman, Tamim Iqbal. Will this cost the Windies a lot?
Starts off with a fuller delivery around off. Tamim goes for the drive but misses it completely.

WE are all set to get underway! The players makes their way out to the middle. Tamim Iqbal and Liton Das are the Bangladesh openers. Oshane Thomas to start the proceedings for the Windies. Here we go...

Carlos Brathwaite says he wanted to bowl first. Informs they are playing with four pacers and he hopes to restrict Bangladesh to a small total. Mentions the guys are rearing to go and he feels this is their best chance to win a series in Bangladesh. Further adds the guys that have come in, are in good form. Ends by saying they are playing 4 pacers and 1 spinner.

Shakib Al Hasan says it looks like a good wicket and he feels it won't change a lot. He hopes to put the Windies under pressure by putting up a good score. He reckons they have a balanced eleven. States the Windies are a better team in the shortest format and they will have to be at their best.
TOSS - Bangladesh win the toss and they elect to bat first.

Pitch report - Tino Mawoyo says it is overcast conditions here but the wicket looks a good one. Further adds there is a little grass but it is well-rolled and hence, the wicket will hold up well. Ends by saying, batting first is the way to go as dew won't play a part.

Steve Rhodes the Bangladesh Coach is giving an interview. He starts by saying, it is a different format and it will be interesting to see how they play. Admits they would love to go higher up on the T20I rankings and they will want to beat the Windies here. States the World Cup is surely on their mind and they are working towards it. Mentions they have ODIs against Ireland and they are looking forward to it. Further adds they will look to entertain the crowd here but also want to win the game.

Coming to the visitors, this is one format they cherish a lot. But lately they have not at been at their best of form losing quite a few games. Carlos Brathwaite will like his side to make a comeback and give a fight in this series. Windies would be hoping their in form player Shai Hope recovers from injury. Should be an interesting contest. Do join us in a bit.

Hello and welcome to the 1st T20I between Bangladesh and Windies from Sylhet. The home side has the momentum on its side after winning a close ODI series. Playing in home conditions, they will be the favorites going into the T20I series.
